reviewer: Codex /root/kings_4_7 (AI-assisted supplied-English author review of 2 Kings 18–21)
review_method: The complete 723-unit 2 Kings inventory was established before the prior run began new-book source review. In this run I first completed the separately requested entire 1 Chronicles inventory, with zero semantic source-review credit. Then I read all 121 complete actual 2 Kings 18–21 source units (37/37/21/26), all proposed retained targets and necessary contexts. The targets and contexts read include complete Isaiah 36–39; 2 Chronicles 29:1–2,31:20–21,32:1–33,33:1–25,28:18–19; Numbers 21:4–9; Deuteronomy 10:19–22; 1 Samuel 3:10–14; 1 Kings 20:17–24; and 2 Kings 16:19–20,17:3–12,24:1–4,24:13–16,22:1–2, with the full 18–21 source narratives supplying local context. I separately reread all125 complete source/target/category/rationale triples in bounded untruncated groups of22/22/22/22/22/15. I preserved the complete original draft, made one five-row author precision stage, and separately reread all five corrected complete triples before freeze. Retained links concern particular regnal recaps, repeated named event accounts, quoted speeches and prayers, specific formulae, reported instructions and outcomes, narrative reversals, and explicitly labelled same-chapter literary relations. No generic pair was added to meet the numerical target. This is an initial supplied-English curated pass, not exhaustive discovery, original-language or apparatus verification, independent human specialist approval, or an independently certified date, name, geography, medical mechanism or physical sign equation.
pin_method: Fresh raw fixed-commit fetches for all seven retained source/target books. Exact Git blob SHA1 against saved immutable source identities, saved raw SHA256 and complete parsed-cache equality verified; raw bytes were rehashed again before freeze. Newline differences remain recorded separately. Inventory and pin checks add zero review credit.

old_row.rationale: Both oracles attribute the outcome involving fortified cities to divine forming or arranging and present bringing or showing. Kings’s exiles of fighting men and Isaiah’s desolation wording remain distinct, without rewriting either into a shared technical conquest formula.

old_row.relationship: The remembrance prayer invokes true conduct and ends in the king’s tears
old_row.rationale: Both prayers ask the Lord to remember Hezekiah’s walk in truth and heartfulness and doing what pleased Him, followed by his weeping. Full heart and true heart, and bitterly and greatly, remain their respective terms and his self-description remains speech.

new_row.relationship: The remembrance prayer invokes true conduct and ends in the king’s tears
new_row.rationale: Both prayers ask the Lord to remember Hezekiah’s walk in truth, his heart and his pleasing conduct, followed by his weeping. Full heart and true heart, and bitterly and greatly, remain their respective terms and his self-description remains speech.

changes.reason: Full-triple author precision: preserve the respective exile/desolation, heart, carved/cast, measure/weight and attack/death wording without adding object counts or an unreported shared verb.

unresolved_candidates.status: pending proposed clause or identity equivalence; no reconciliation credit
unresolved_candidates.reason: Kings says the eyes were lifted on high against Israel’s Holy One; Isaiah says they were not lifted toward Him. The retained pair compares the explicit reproach, raised voice and named Holy One while preserving both eye clauses; their polarity is not reconciled.

unresolved_candidates.status: pending proposed clause or identity equivalence; no reconciliation credit
unresolved_candidates.reason: Kings’s first-year self-growing food and second-year sprouts differ from Isaiah’s first-year what-you-have-sown and second-year what-remains. The retained comparison credits the explicit three-stage sign, third-year sowing, harvest and vineyards, not an agricultural equivalence.

unresolved_candidates.status: pending proposed clause or identity equivalence; no reconciliation credit
unresolved_candidates.reason: Kings records a question about a healing sign and third-day Lord-house visit, while Isaiah records This is the sign that I will go up. The bounded sign-and-visit comparison does not harmonize question and statement or insert a third day into Isaiah.

unresolved_candidates.status: pending proposed clause or identity equivalence; no reconciliation credit
unresolved_candidates.reason: Kings names Marodachbaladan son of Baladan and letters and manaa; Isaiah names Marodach son of Laadan with letters, envoys and gifts and adds recovery. The retained illness-triggered Babylonian embassy comparison does not certify the names, filiation or manaa/gifts as identical.

unresolved_candidates.status: pending proposed clause or identity equivalence; no reconciliation credit
unresolved_candidates.reason: Both predict ancestral and household possessions reaching Babylon, but Kings concludes No word which the Lord spoke shall be left over while Isaiah says nothing will be left behind. The retained shared Babylon warning does not equate the distinct word-versus-goods clauses.

candidate_exclusions.proposed_claim: Reconcile every Isaiah-Kings name, eye polarity, agricultural stage, sign grammar, sun/shadow description, embassy filiation or concluding word/goods clause; turn advance-if-return into an unquoted choice; translate manaa, nechotha, melon or rivers of enclosure; replace alabaster jar with bowl or Ahab-house weight with Samaria’s measure; assign every quoted Assyrian claim narrator authority; count carved/cast terms as independently separate images; derive a medical mechanism or an engineering survey.
candidate_exclusions.reason: Only explicit bounded connections are retained. The actual differing clauses and supplied English terms remain visible, with no unsupported equation or technical gloss credited.

editorial_notes.note: Preserve all original wording and fields. Retain Abou/Abba and Zechariah/Zacharias; Neesthan and Moses’s serpent; actual Assyrian and envoy name forms; three hundred silver and thirty gold as imposed rather than audited weights; Syrian/Judean; drinking from vine versus Isaiah eating; eyes lifted versus not lifted; melon, Carmel, cooled and foreign waters, rivers of enclosure, exile wording, hook/muzzle and first-year crop differences;185000 camp strike; Neserach/Nasarach and Ararat/Armenia; middle courtyard; fifteen years; fig-cake directions; actual third-day question versus sign statement; forward-if-return shadow sentence and backward ten-step report; Marodachbaladan/Baladan versus Marodach/Laadan, manaa and nechotha; no word left over versus no goods left behind; no independently named eunuch descendant; Opsiba, Mesollam/Arous/Jeteba; singular altars, charmer and knowing ones; carved/cast image term scope; Samaria’s measure, Ahab-house weight and alabaster jar; innocent blood, Oza’s garden and Amon/Josiah succession.
